name: ASASSN-15lx field (Hubble)
blurb: ASASSN-15lx field, the site of a probable Type IIn supernova, seen by Hubble.
label: asassn15lx-hubble
story: A supernova flared here near the galaxy ESO 047-G004, and its spectrum showed the narrow hydrogen glow of a possible Type IIn explosion. Years later Hubble returned to ask whether such blasts truly destroy their stars.

claims.text: ASASSN-15lx is a probable supernova discovered by ASAS-SN near the galaxy ESO 047-G004, at RA 20:36:05.24, Dec -73:06:32.41
Its spectrum showed narrow H-alpha emission, suggesting a Type IIn event
Program 17731 imaged sites of confirmed Type IIn supernovae years after outburst to test whether they are terminal explosions; ASASSN-15LX is target 20
